'''Dalesham''' was a [[General/Legends|General]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. He was the commander of the local Separatist forces on [[Innton II]]. After the ''[[Nova Defiant/Legends|Nova Defiant]]'' crashed on the planet, he ordered the relocation of parts of the ship to the [[Great Cavern]] to be build into a [[Defiant Core|base]]. The [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] ended before the base could be completed and the Separatists abandoned it. Later the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] would come across the base, turning it into the [[Defiant Core]].<ref name="SoR" />
